title: Presentation Templates
slide_intent: Teach presenters to select one recurring frame for a talk. A stable edge treatment helps the audience recognize title, content and section changes.
strategic_value: CSAIL can support single-brand and dual-brand talks without relocating its identifier on every slide.
demonstration: Two labeled sets of six thumbnails compare the horizontal footer and vertical sidebar across several kinds of slides, including photo-led and text-heavy examples.
practical_value: Use one family throughout the presentation. Choose the sidebar for dual branding when the second logo needs the opposite side.

content_islands.name: Selection guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation of templates, dual branding and dark backgrounds in the left column.

content_islands.name: Horizontal-footer family
content_islands.spec: Arrange six thumbnails in two rows below the family label. Vary content while keeping the warm footer device.

content_islands.name: Vertical-sidebar family
content_islands.spec: Repeat the six-up comparison below, using the edge stripe so viewers can compare the two systems.
